scope: Read-only buildability triage of the trimmed architecture plan against current source, tests, receipts, and live process tooling. No runtime source changed.

inputs.name: parent-source-audit
inputs.result: Mapped docs/architecture.md, docs/status.md, services/supervisor, the desktop launch path, CMake targets, the pinned Qt build, and the R2/R3 account and paste implementations.

inputs.name: focused-supervisor-gate
inputs.result: The current clean-head daemon/runtime gate passed after selecting the repository's pinned Qt 6.11.2 prefix.

inputs.name: birth-route-worker
inputs.result: Defined the LiveConnection create-admission seam while preserving direct service arguments, preview rejection, descriptor ownership, and v6 compatibility.

inputs.name: parallel-gates-worker
inputs.result: Identified current R2 verification surfaces and a local R3 credential-validation parity defect.

inputs.name: supervisor-client-worker
inputs.result: The 600-second read-only worker timed out; its report was not used. Parent source inspection and the live gate cover this area.

findings.slice: Make the focused supervisor gate reproducible from the normal launcher
findings.evidence: Without a Qt prefix, standalone CMake selected Homebrew Qt 6.12.0 and failed the exact-version Qt 6.11.2 lookup. With CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH pointing at build/release/qt, configure, build, all focused tests, real-service integration, and daemon integration passed at c28a871.
findings.boundary: This is an environment/dispatch repair, not a runtime behavior change.

findings.evidence: State v2, bounded effective-UID framing, real service birth/adoption, authenticated control codecs, and process-level tests already exist. The daemon control handler currently interprets every request as birth and exposes no status/stop client.
findings.buildable_contract: Add strict action dispatch, read-only status that omits secrets and launch details, a headless client verb, and authenticated stop. Failed or unknown birth remains terminal.
findings.acceptance: Extend the real daemon/service/terminal test to prove status before and after birth, stop cleanup, stale token/epoch rejection, malformed framing, and foreign-UID refusal.

findings.blocked_reason: SupervisorRegistry has no clear-slot transition, and persisted v1 startup fails before the control endpoint exists. An explicit choice is required between a bounded daemon recovery mode and an offline locked-state disposition path.
findings.non_claim: No reset implementation or recovery-mode decision is made by this triage.

findings.evidence: LiveConnection owns direct create admission and currently chooses the client session ID before starting a detached service. Supervisor birth returns a daemon-selected ID and epoch, so the existing ServiceLauncher callback alone cannot express the route.
findings.buildable_contract: Put DirectBirthRoute, SupervisorBirthRoute, and BirthTicket at LiveConnection create admission. Direct behavior stays byte-equivalent; supervisor birth is one-shot with no fallback; a born ticket supplies both identity fields to the existing v6 attach path.
findings.dependency: Build after headless status/stop so operator disposition exists before GUI routing.

findings.evidence: Service-owned paste admission, mode-aware encoding, bounded queues, cancellation, reconnect uncertainty, and desktop ownership tests already exist, but current-head assembled evidence is missing.
findings.buildable_contract: Run and record the real-service paste/backpressure/identity suites at this source before package-dependent candidate claims.
findings.non_claim: Background Qt or service-only results do not substitute for native macOS input or packaged candidate acceptance.

findings.evidence: Remote Claude validation rejects oversized or multi-line tokens and remote Codex validation requires a JSON object. Local Claude reads only 8192 bytes and trims; local Codex checks only that auth.json is readable. Oversized or malformed local selected credentials can therefore pass preflight.
findings.buildable_contract: Reuse the remote validation boundaries for local kept plans and add focused workspace account cases that refuse before replacing or launching a healthy session.
findings.non_claim: Fixture refusal does not qualify a real provider account or packaged host.

validation.name: focused-supervisor-unpinned-qt
validation.result: CMake found Homebrew Qt 6.12.0 and rejected the exact Qt 6.11.2 requirement.

validation.name: focused-supervisor-pinned-qt
validation.result: Configure, build, focused tests, real-service integration, and daemon integration all passed.

validation.name: source-parity-check
validation.command: rg and direct reads of workspace.cpp, live_connection.cpp, supervisor state/runtime/daemon sources, and focused tests
validation.result: The stated ownership boundaries and local credential validation asymmetry are present at c28a871.

non_claims: This triage implements no supervisor, CLI, GUI, account, input, package, or runtime behavior.
The passing focused gate does not qualify launchd, GUI replacement, reboot, package update, credential environments, load, memory, or latency.
Worker audits are source inspection only; the runtime route field was unavailable, so no served-model claim is made.
The ignored build receipt and worker outputs are execution context; this sanitized evidence receipt is the durable consolidation.
